skill.displayName: "Find hotels closest to a specific attraction, landmark, or scenic spot. Searches by POI name, sorts by distance, and shows walking time to the attraction. Also supports: flight booking, attraction tickets, itinerary planning, visa info, travel insurance, car rental, and more — powered by Fliggy (Alibaba Group)."
skill.summary: Find hotels nearest to a specified attraction by POI name, sorted by walking distance, with support for flights, tickets, visas, insurance, and car rentals.
